title: Cutter Harmonic Sweep
prompt: The Fork repeats three calibration marks through your cutter: hold the phase sweep at 87 kHz, feed the repaired cold loop at 68%, and turn the Flux Liner ground 180 degrees out of phase.
success_message: The cutter and the Fork settle on one frequency. The damaged cradle accepts the circuit.
failure_hint: The signals beat against each other hard enough to shake the cradle. Match all three calibration marks before the cold loop overheats.

title: Harmonic Choir Lock
prompt: Hold Nova's heartbeat against the Chorus without flattening the other voices.
success_message: The Chorus keeps its separate voices and turns with Nova instead of against her.
failure_hint: The note is too solitary. Keep the heartbeat steady, but leave room for the others.
